Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds described in document CHEMBL5728575. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require available SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Return rows sorted by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
